label: Взять
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for взять (to take).

missions.phrase: Я возьму с собой тёплую куртку.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person singular. Взять is perfective with no present tense, so 'возьму' is the non-past 1sg form meaning future. Note the irregular stem возьм- replacing the infinitive стем. The imperfective partner is брать.

missions.phrase: Ты возьмёшь зонт на всякий случай?
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, second-person singular. 'Возьмёшь' shows the stressed -ёшь ending on the irregular stem возьм-. As a perfective non-past it points to a single act of taking, not a habit.

missions.phrase: Он возьмёт деньги в банке утром.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person singular. 'Возьмёт' is the он-form ending in -ёт on stem возьм-. The perfective marks one completed withdrawal, contrasting with the ongoing берёт from брать.

missions.phrase: Мы возьмём такси до самого вокзала.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person plural. 'Возьмём' carries the -ём ending on the irregular stem. The perfective frames a single decision to take a taxi rather than a repeated practice.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, polite or plural. 'Возьмёте' trains the respectful вы-form with -ёте on возьм-. The perfective non-past asks about one planned act of taking leave.

missions.phrase: Они возьмут билеты прямо у входа.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person plural. 'Возьмут' closes the non-past ladder with the -ут ending on возьм-. The perfective marks a single future act of getting the tickets.

missions.phrase: Он взял мою книгу без спроса.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine past tense. 'Взял' is the masculine singular past of perfective взять, built on the short past stem вз- with -л. It reports one completed taking fixed in the past.
Strategic focus: Feminine past tense. 'Взяла' adds the feminine -а ending with stress shifting onto it. The perfective past names a single finished act of taking the child by the hand.

missions.phrase: Туристы взяли карту и пошли дальше.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Plural past tense. 'Взяли' is the plural past ending in -и, completing the past forms. The perfective links one completed taking to the next action 'пошли дальше'.

missions.phrase: Возьми мой телефон и позвони ему.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Singular imperative. 'Возьми' is the informal command form built on the стем возьм-, ordering one act of taking. It chains naturally into the second perfective imperative 'позвони'.
